Noo-Noo Disk Guardian — Wave 2: See the Patterns, Generalize the Smarts

Status: BUILDING — Decide complete 2026-07-16: 8 slices filed and published (see Wave plan below), charter D15–D26 committed (barkpark 95c9d6dba), builders dispatch next. This Paper is the wave's living story: Digest will append the survey digest + verify plan; Decide appends decisions + the slice plan; Review closes it as the debrief.

Epic task: noo-noo-disk-guardian-epic · Wave 1 (grade A-) is MERGED to noo-noo main (91eb2b5: sizer, leaks, audit ledger, offload, velocity all live; v0.5.0 installed as launchd daemon on the reference machine). Repo: /Volumes/SATECHI/github/noo-noo. Gates: CC=/usr/bin/clang go test -race ./... && go vet ./.... Builders work in worktrees; lead merges.

The wish (verbatim)

“Yes - fix remaining - Make sure that every smart thing you do, is something that Noo Noo should help with - this is my software - but i want it to be helpful for people in general - people like me - i believe many developers have problems alike - and its nice to have a tool that just makes sure that performance halt because of storage issues wont happen etc.”

“We want to literally see the patterns happening, giving able to foresight reoccurring or cumulative issues - also able to see state of computer - if it is stuck with one small disk, or is able to more conveniently offload.”

Direction

Wave 2 turns noo-noo from a one-machine rescue kit into a general disk-guardian product with eyes. The finished experience, for any developer on any Mac:

  1. noo-noo status — machine posture in one honest statement. Internal disk size / free / real fill-rate, days-until-full projected from recorded velocity, external volumes with volguard verdicts (usable headroom vs media-read-only vs corrupt) — “you are stuck on one small 228G disk” vs “you have 1.7T usable external headroom.”
  2. noo-noo trends — patterns literally visible. Per-asset-class growth curves as terminal sparkline tables from the store's time-series; simple honest forecasting (linear fit over a cited window — no ML theater); recurrence detection: a leak class that re-appears (Chrome code_sign_clone re-leaking weekly) surfaces as a PATTERN with a permanent-remediation suggestion from its signature's workaround field (e.g. --disable-features=MacAppCodeSignClone), not another one-off cleanup.
  3. The daemon closes the founding leak loop. Leaks run on tick + pressure triggers with a notification naming the leak and the one command that fixes it (absorbs nn-bl-daemon-leak-alerts). Detect → alert → fix, end to end.
  4. Every manual smart from 2026-07-15 becomes product, machine-agnostic. Playbooks templated on [offload] dest_root — zero /Volumes/SATECHI hardcoding (b1). New capability classes, each proven by a live incident: orphaned headless-browser process signatures pinning files + spawning clone leaks (b3); VM inner-disk fullness detection for colima/lima — dockerd silently dead on a full datadisk is the wish's “performance halt” verbatim (b2); ShipIt updater-cache targets (b9); media-RO vs fs-corruption volume health — never suggest repair on write-locked hardware, rescue-copy first (b7, absorbs nn-bl-volume-health).
  5. The offload story completes. Session-safe deferred relocation (stop-gated assets queue and re-check on the daily tick or an explicit offload pending, under the multi-gate consent law) (b4); sub-asset playbook children with their own lsof gates — a locked parent's cold bulky subdirs are still relocatable (b5); resumable, verifiable multi-GB moves (rsync-delta or chunked copy+verify — never a bare mv that loses 10 minutes on interruption) (b6); and the -y flag-parse trust bug fixed across ALL subcommands — a silent no-op on an explicit consent flag is a trust bug (b8).

Tentative choices (Decide finalizes after survey + verify): CLI-first — status and trends as the two new surfaces; Wails menubar only if a surveyor proves the toolchain green in a worktree. Recurrence detection reads persisted per-signature scan history (persist leak-scan results to the store if wave 1 didn't). Ride the existing seams: modules.Module contract, heuristics for daemon surfacing, signatures/playbooks as data, sizer as THE size source, safety multi-gate law untouched. Priority: b1 + a1–a3 are the wave's heart (the user's own words); b3+b10 close the founding loop; b4+b5+b6 complete offload; b2/b7/b8/b9 ride as small proven slices. Absorb/supersede overlapping nn-bl-* children — never duplicate them.

Surveyors dispatched. Next: Digest folds scout reports here and designs the verify fleet.

Survey digest (Digest phase, 2026-07-16)

Status: VERIFYING — 16 survey reports folded; 10 verifiers designed below and in flight. All 16 surveyors failed to search Barkpark prior art because they typed bp search <terms>; the real verb is bp search query. Prior-art checks were undone, not empty — Decide should spot-check with the correct verb.

Established (file:line evidence, cross-confirmed)

  • The visibility pillar is new construction, not wiring. The store has 6 tables; the ONLY time-series is cache_size_history (per cache-ROOT, 3 configured roots, bytes=sizer.Blocks). There is no disk-free/system-metrics series, no leak-scan persistence, no volume inventory, no retention anywhere (schema.sql exhaustive; internal/metrics is live-sample-only; the pressure watcher's ring buffer is discarded). a1 (forecast) and a3 (posture) each need a new table + new collector; a2 (recurrence) needs a new persistence path. CacheVelocity is a 2-point ratio check, not a regression — a1's linear fit is genuinely new.
  • Live daemon state (v0.5.0, pid-confirmed): store at ~/Library/Application Support/noo-noo/store.db, schema v2 = HEAD exactly, created fresh 2026-07-15 (~8h of data). 276 cache_size_history rows = 92 samples/root in ~8h — the pressure watcher dominates the cadence, not the daily 03:00 tick. Any forecast must day-bucket. All other tables 0 rows (explained: 7-day velocity window, 30-day idle threshold, autoclean off by default — except repo_idleness=0 which is unexplained).
  • Schema evolution: migrate() re-executes one monolithic idempotent CREATE IF NOT EXISTS schema.sql on every Open(). New tables = zero ceremony for the running daemon; no ALTER TABLE path exists — a new column on an existing table is unprecedented and must be designed, not assumed.
  • b8 proven by repro: five subcommands (caches, dev, leaks, offload, startup) share the identical fs.Parse(args)-before-verb trap; -y after the verb is silently discarded and Confirm() reads EOF → silent abort exit 0. autoclean_cmd.go (verb-first, per-verb FlagSets) is the correct-by-construction reference. The e2e test masks the bug by placing flags before the verb.
  • b1 is narrowly confined: exactly 3 NativeCommand literals hardcode /Volumes/SATECHI (playbook.go:64,71,79); no UUIDs in prod code; ClassRelocate already flows DestRoot generically (offload.go:261); DefaultPlaybooks() is called with zero args from the single production call site (offload_cmd.go:31-34, passes playbooks=nil). Open design point: template at construction vs render-time (offload.go:180), + unconfigured-dest_root fallback.
  • b3 is greenfield: zero process-enumeration/kill primitives exist repo-wide. The leaks Signature/glob/lstat/RemoveAll/CanDeleteLeakTarget machinery is structurally path-shaped and cannot host a process target; b3 = new sibling module implementing modules.Module with a data-driven ProcessSignature registry, a new op (Op enum today is delete|disable|enable|clear|relocate), and its own kill-safety story. Composes with the existing chrome-code-sign-clone signature by sequencing, no shared code.
  • b10 is a 3-seam wiring job blocked by one gap: seams = collectSuggestions branch (tick.go:84-93), tickNotify signature-naming copy (tick.go:167-179; Signature.Workaround already carries the permanent fix text), menubar Status enrichment (cmd/noo-noo-app/main.go:60 feeds nil; main.go:118-119 discards fetched items). The gap: heuristics.Suggestion has no Size field across type/store-row/IPC while menubar.Suggestion.SizeBytes render is built+tested. Charter D8 (ride the single trig channel) is satisfied automatically; D11 forbids the 3-path unification — the fix must be a minimal patch.
  • b6 reframed: offload Apply never shells to mv; discard-partial-on-failure is tested intentional behavior (TestApplyMidCopyFailureRestoresOriginal) and source data is provably never damaged. The 13G-mv incident happened outside the tool. b6 = new resumability capability, not a bug fix. Constraint: macOS /usr/bin/rsync is openrsync with no --acls flag — wholesale rsync regresses ditto's ACL guarantee; chunked-ditto per top-level child is the fidelity-preserving shape. Copier is already an injection seam; dest-exists-refusal (317-319) + unconditional RemoveAll (325-328) are the two lines that must become resume-aware, plus an in-flight marker for SIGKILL orphans.
  • b4 has nothing to ride: zero queue/pending mechanism repo-wide; offload's audit is append-only JSONL (structurally cannot hold in_progress→resolved); auto_clean_events' two-phase crash-pivot is the pattern to copy into a new table. Offload has zero daemon-tick presence today — b4 adds the first. Stop-gates evaluate at Apply only (offload.go:303-311); Scan/Plan merely display them.
  • b5 is smaller than briefed: flat sibling playbook rows already "nest" by accident (exact-path matching everywhere); the live ~/.claude/jobs trick works today as a second row. Missing piece = a path-scoped gate: leaks.LsofProbe is exactly the needed primitive, unwired into offload. One gate-kind field + one Deps prober ≈ done; ParentAssetID grouping is cosmetic.
  • b2 is greenfield with live-proven mechanics: only colima knowledge in repo is the relocation playbook. colima ssh -- df is ground truth for inner fullness (~0.4s, daemon-tick-cheap); colima list --json reports allocation only. Data disk (--disk, docker storage) ≠ root disk. Grow suggestion must VolGuard-resolve where COLIMA_HOME physically lives first. Overlaps open backlog nn-bl-disable-class (cap/disable suggestions) — coordinate, don't duplicate.
  • b9 is small code, not data: caches module is literal-path os.Stat, no glob; live ShipIt dirs include a build-generated non-guessable bundle ID (com.todesktop.230313…, ~1.6G total) — literal paths cannot generalize. Borrow leaks' filepath.Glob pattern (module-level or defaultCacheTargets-level). Safety root already covers it.
  • a4 toolchain PROVEN GREEN by actual runs: build/vet/race/package all pass via repo Makefile (no wails3 CLI needed or installed). BUT frontend/dist is never embedded — no go:embed, no Assets field in application.Options — so the Settings webview would render blank. If Wails is taken, "embed dist via Assets" is a prerequisite sub-task.
  • Backlog mapping (10 nn-bl-* children): ABSORB 5 — daemon-leak-alerts→b10, volume-health→b7 (after correction, see conflict below), auto-relocate-gates→b4, disable-class→a2+b2, wails-ui→a4. DEFER action-unify (charter D11) and snapshot-signal (D10). LEAVE store-retention (coordinate windows with a1), home-symlink-guard, toggle-persist as standalone backlog.

Contradictions and unknowns the Decide phase cannot live without

  1. Kompis diagnosis conflict (b7). nn-bl-volume-health says fsck-confirmed CORRUPTION + backup-then-repair recipe; the wave mandate says hardware Media Read-Only where repair is IMPOSSIBLE. Same volume, same UUID, opposite remediations. Building b7 off the stale task text would ship the exact mistake b7 exists to prevent. → live diskutil verdict required.
  2. Dual scan-path ambiguity (b10). daemon-tick-seams anchors ticks in tick.go RunTick; daemon-live-state attributes live writes to main.go:275 runScan. If two pipelines are live, a leaks branch in one silently misses the other. → must be settled before the b10 brief is written.
  3. actions-table writer contradiction. store-schema-map: "orphaned, no caller"; recurrence-data + daemon-live-state: written by internal/ipc/clean_method.go. Decides whether b4 reuses or ignores that table.
  4. Size-gap fix shape (b10, D11-compliant). Where does autoclean's MinSizeMB gate source size TODAY if Suggestion has no Size field? What actually ripples when SizeBytes is added (store column? IPC? tests)? → needs a probe edit, not prose.
  5. Pressure cadence anomaly. 92 samples/8h means pressure triggers fire near-continuously — either thresholds are permanently met (itself a posture red flag) or debounce is broken. Skews a1 forecasting and b4's "re-check on tick" cadence. Plus: repo_idleness=0 rows unexplained.
  6. colima grow semantics unproven (stop-first? hot?), and limactl generalization untested.
  7. leaks↔offload import cycle unverified for b5's PathProber reuse; volguard.go never fully read.
  8. Zero-ceremony new-table claim should be proven against a copy of the LIVE store.db before four slices bet on it.
  9. Baseline gates on noo-noo main (91eb2b5) not yet run this session — builders must branch from proven green.

Coverage map — where surveyors went, and where nobody went

Checked and found: internal/store (all 6 table-owner files + tests), internal/scan, internal/heuristics (both), internal/leaks (leaks.go/module.go/lsof.go), internal/modules (module.go contract, offload complete incl. tests, caches, dev), internal/core (safety.go, volguard.go partial), internal/cli (all 13 subcommand files + confirm.go + output.go + e2e test), internal/autoclean (config.go, apply.go), cmd/noo-nood (main.go, tick.go), cmd/noo-noo-app (main.go, bindings, frontend, Makefile targets — built live), cmd/noo-noo (main.go ctx), internal/audit, internal/ipc (protocol, report_method, clean_method), internal/menubar (menu, poller), internal/notify, internal/metrics, internal/pressure (disk.go partial), live store.db, live colima surface, live diskutil keys, live ShipIt dirs, all 10 nn-bl-* task bodies, charter D8/D10/D11.

Checked and NOT found (absences that shape the plan): no system-metrics/disk-capacity table; no leak-scan persistence; no retention/VACUUM; no queue/pending/deferred mechanism; no process-enumeration or kill primitive; no glob support in caches; no nesting concept in playbooks; no verifyVolume/fsck/repairVolume caller; no WritableMedia parsing; no `diskutil list` (multi-volume) usage; no go:embed of the Wails frontend; no context timeout in the Apply chain; no verb-then-flags test coverage; no wails3 CLI (moot — unused).

Corners no surveyor reached: internal/pressure/watch.go+vmstat.go debounce internals (only skimmed); internal/menubar/click.go; test/e2e/pressure_scan_test.go; autoclean budget.go; volguard.go full read; the five unread CLI test files (skimmed via grep only); Barkpark prior-art search (wrong verb used by all 16).

Verify plan — 10 verifiers, the LAST look before Decide

Verification results (Decide fold-in, 2026-07-16)

10 verifiers ran; every load-bearing claim below carries actually-run output. Trust order held: proofs > facts > prose.

Coverage not-founds that shaped the cut: zero ps/kill primitives repo-wide (b3 is greenfield → D20); no queue/pending mechanism anywhere (b4 needs a NEW two-phase table → D24); leaks results never persisted (recurrence rides the suggestions table once b10 wires the tick); menubar.Suggestion constructed nowhere in production; offload Apply never uses mv and never loses data — the 13G incident was a manual mv OUTSIDE the tool (b6 REFRAMED → D23, backlogged as nn-bl-resumable-copy); Wails toolchain proven green but frontend/dist is never embedded (blank Settings window → D26, stays backlog).

Decisions (mirrored from charter D15–D26 — the charter is the epic’s memory, this is the wave’s story)

  • D15 — RunTick/collectSuggestions is THE daemon insertion point; runScan and TriggerManual are dead; the actions table is orphaned — new state gets NEW tables.
  • D16 — Schema evolution = CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS appended to schema.sql, NEVER ALTER (migrate() re-execs the whole file every Open; proven safe against the live store).
  • D17 — SizeBytes is a first-class field on heuristics.Suggestion; persistence via the evidence_json carry, no new column; sizes source from sizer.UniqueAllocated.
  • D18 — Posture reads are CLI-fresh (statfs/diskutil in-process), no new IPC this wave; the ~5-min pressure cadence is a designed posture SIGNAL to report; all forecasting day-buckets.
  • D19 — Playbooks template on {dest_root} rendered at read time; sub-assets are flat sibling rows; the new bit is the path-scoped gate via injected leaks.LsofProbe (cycle-free).
  • D20 — Process signatures are a SIBLING module (internal/procsig), new Op “terminate”, own safety predicate — never a leaks-registry extension.
  • D21 — colima truth: datadisk (--disk) is what fills; grow = stop + start --disk N (automatic resize); lima detection must special-case LIMA_HOME=$COLIMA_HOME/_lima; grow only with proven host-volume headroom.
  • D22 — CLI verb-first flag law: strip the verb BEFORE flag.Parse (autoclean is the reference); hard-error on stray flag-looking args; natural-order protective tests.
  • D23 — b6 reframed and BACKLOGGED (nn-bl-resumable-copy): Apply never loses data; resumability is a new capability (chunked-ditto — openrsync has no --acls). The wave slot goes to b4.
  • D24 — Deferred relocation = new two-phase relocation_queue table modeled on auto_clean_events; daily-tick auto-apply behind an autoclean-style multi-gate cascade; pressure NEVER applies.
  • D25 — Scan roots EvalSymlinks before walking (proven silent 100% failure on symlinked roots).
  • D26 — Wails stays backlog: toolchain proven green, but go:embed of frontend/dist is the prerequisite; wave 2 is CLI-first.

All slices: worktrees off noo-noo main 91eb2b5; gate = CC=/usr/bin/clang go test -race ./... && CC=/usr/bin/clang go vet ./... (dry-run green at baseline). The dispatch frontier sequences file collisions; disjoint slices fly in parallel. Lead merges; builders never push.

Backlog seeded this wave: nn-bl-resumable-copy (D23), nn-bl-ipc-dead-surface, nn-bl-memratio-accuracy. Absorbed/superseded (kept open, lead closes with their wave task): nn-bl-daemon-leak-alerts → slice 5; nn-bl-volume-health → slices 1+2 (diagnosis corrected per D7); nn-bl-auto-relocate-gates → slice 8. nn-bl-disable-class scope-corrected (colima portion → slice 7, Chrome workaround surfacing → slice 2 recurrence; actions-runner cruft remains). nn-bl-wails-ui carries the D26 embed prerequisite.

In flight: builders dispatched — 8 published, claimable tasks under noo-noo-disk-guardian-epic. Review closes this Paper as the debrief.

Review debrief — wave complete (2026-07-16), grade A-

Where the wave stands: CLOSED. All 8 slices built with green gates; the reviewer (last hands before merge) read every diff, fixed in place on -r branches, re-ran every slice gate plus the full integrated gate, live-smoked the merged binary, and audited the ledger. Nothing is in flight; the lead merges the train below.

What shipped (merge in this order — plain merges, the two -r branches complete the train)

  1. nn-w2-posture-data → loop-epic/posture-data-layer-disk-space-history-wr-0 (5ac9f9e, unchanged by review). disk_space_history (D16-clean), core.ListVolumes + VolumeCapacity with the D7 WritableMedia discriminator, ListSuggestionsSince (recurrence read, dismissed included), the D25 symlinked-scan-root fix with an adversarially proven fails-on-main test. Verdict: clean foundation, no fixes needed.
  2. nn-w2-status-trends → loop-epic/noo-noo-status-trends-machine-posture-in-1 (612a2ad, unchanged; contains posture-data). The wave's heart and its best code: pure internal/trend (day-bucket → least-squares → days-until-full, recurrence ≥2 distinct UTC days, sparklines), status/trends with honest insufficient-history fallbacks, D7-correct volume verdicts pinned by tests that BAN repair copy on media-RO, the D18 pressure-density signal, and the closing stuck-vs-headroom verdict — the user's own words, rendered live ("You have 1.6 TB of usable external headroom…"). Verdict: excellent; no fixes needed.
  3. nn-w2-cli-flag-trust → loop-epic/cli-trust-flags-after-the-verb-parse-cor-2 (cc8f2ca, unchanged). One shared parseVerb seam fixes the proven silent -y no-op across all five commands, both argument orders, table-tested + e2e natural-order companions; ShipIt glob ride-along. Verdict: exactly right size; no fixes needed.
  4. nn-w2-playbook-generalize → loop-epic/playbooks-machine-agnostic-dest-root-nat-3 (2a590ff, unchanged). {dest_root} templating rendered at read time (grep for /Volumes/SATECHI in production code = zero), GatePath sub-asset gate over an injected lsof prober, claude-jobs shipped as the proven exemplar. Verdict: clean; no fixes needed on its own branch (its integration gap was in the queue slice — see 8).
  5. nn-w2-daemon-leak-alerts → loop-epic/daemon-closes-the-founding-leak-loop-lea-4 (cb5fbb4, unchanged; one gofmt miss in leaks_test.go corrected on the train). Leaks fire on daily+pressure ticks via a diagnose-only LeakSource, one leak-named alert per signature class with real GB + workaround verbatim, SizeBytes end-to-end through the evidence_json carry, menubar suggestions finally wired (the "Task 57" nil is gone). Verdict: solid; residue filed as nn-bl-leaks-tick-cadence (registry runs on every ~5-min pressure tick — fine today, linear cost on hot machines).
  6. nn-w2-orphan-processes → loop-epic/internal-procsig-orphaned-automation-bro-5 (78ac483, unchanged). Registry-as-data process signatures, ps through the OutputRunner idiom, terminate behind own-uid + ppid==1 + fresh-ps TOCTOU re-verification, CLI verb-safe from birth, kill output points at leaks clean — the founding causal loop closed by sequencing. Live diagnose smoke found the 3 real 8–11-day orphans. Verdict: strong safety engineering; cosmetic --json/text mixing filed as nn-bl-orphans-json-purity.
  7. nn-w2-vm-disk → loop-epic/vm-inner-disk-fullness-colima-lima-datad-6-r (d362d1f — REVIEW-FIXED). The package was complete and hermetically tested (colima+lima incl. the $COLIMA_HOME/_lima invisibility trap, datadisk-not-rootdisk per D21, headroom-guarded grow / relocate-then-grow / honest blocked), but its status wiring — the criterion the builder honestly stamped as a miss — didn't exist because status_cmd.go lived in an unmerged sibling. Review stacked the branch on status-trends and wired Detector.Report into gatherStatus + RenderSection into the text view + vm_datadisks rows into -json, pinned by TestStatusRendersVMSection. Criterion 2 stamped met with this evidence.
  8. nn-w2-relocation-queue → loop-epic/session-safe-deferred-relocation-two-pha-7-r (REVIEW-FIXED; contains merges of ALL predecessors — the conflict-free train closer). The slice itself is strong: two-phase relocation_queue modeled on auto_clean_events, EnqueueDeferred refusing anything Apply couldn't legally attempt, RunPending re-running EVERY gate fresh, --defer/prompt consent (-y never auto-consents), daemon step 3b behind the autoclean-style two-key cascade with budget 1/tick and pressure forbidden. Review fixes on the -r branch: (a) real capability gap — path-gated sub-assets (the claude-jobs shape, this wave's own exemplar) were undeferrable because ErrStopGate wrapped only the process gate; Apply now wraps the path-gate refusal, RunPending re-probes the subtree fresh, the consent prompt names the right clear-condition, and TestRunPendingPathGatedSubAsset pins blocked→cleared→applied end-to-end; (b) D22 contradiction — this slice hard-errored legacy flags-before-verb while flag-trust deliberately kept it legal on the other four commands; resolved to sibling parity (offload adopts the shared parseVerb; the stricter test updated to pin the shared contract); (c) merge resolutions — schema.sql carries both v3 tables, tick.go carries both step 3b and leak-named notifications, duplicate tickTestDaemon helper deduped and pending tick tests made hermetic (leaks heuristic off). Post-seal, the full-gate re-run under load exposed one more real defect the review then killed: the D25 symlink fix un-masked that three cmd/noo-nood tests walk the REAL home tree through config.Defaults() scan roots (~/Documents/GitHub is itself the symlink D25 exists for, so the once-silently-skipped root became a walk of the entire external github tree — 141s ballooning to a 600s package timeout). Fixed by making TestRunScanRespectsDisabledHeuristics / TestStartShutdown / TestEndToEnd hermetic (nil roots, leaks off); cmd/noo-nood now runs in ~8s and the full -race -count=1 gate re-sealed green.

Proofs on the final state

  • Per-slice wave gate (CC=/usr/bin/clang go test -race ./... && go vet ./...) re-run green on every final branch, including both -r branches.
  • Integrated train (relocation-queue-r = all 8 merged): full -race + vet green.
  • Live smoke of the merged binary on the reference machine (diagnose-only): status renders internal posture + externals with D7 verdicts + offload health + pressure signal + verdict; trends renders sparkline tables with honest empty states; orphans list reads the live process table safely.

What stalled

Nothing. 8/8 slices built (wave 1 was 4/5). Two surfaces remain unproven live by design: days-until-full needs ~3 days of disk_space_history after the merged daemon deploys, and recurrence needs persisted leak suggestions (they start flowing the moment daemon-leak-alerts is live) — both fixture-proven now, both named in the handoff.

Grade: A- (honest commentary)

Genuinely strong: the wave delivers both pillars of the wish nearly in full — the machine's story is literally visible (fill-rate with cited windows, days-until-full, recurrence with permanent remediation, one honest posture verdict in the user's own vocabulary), and every 2026-07-15 manual smart became a general capability (b1–b5, b7–b10 shipped; b6 charter-backlogged per D23 with its consumer named). Code quality is consistently high: pure math separated from I/O, injectable seams everywhere, honest empty/error states, safety laws (D4/D7/D22/D24) pinned by tests that would fail loudly if regressed, and a ledger stamped mid-claim including an honest miss. Why not A: the wave needed its review layer to be mergeable as a coherent product — three real cross-slice defects (path-gated assets undeferrable, two builders shipping contradictory D22 contracts, vm-disk's section unwired) existed at builder-done, and dispatch repeated wave-1's known "branch after X merges" mid-wave flaw, which builders survived by stacking rather than stalling (plus one accidental dual-spawn needing lead arbitration). Judgment constants (batch-collapse gap, nearContinuous=100, 85% VM threshold) are reasonable but uncited; a few polish gaps (orphans --json purity, notification truncation) are filed, not fixed.

Ledger audit

Cleanest wave yet. All 8 slice tasks in_progress with only merge-gate criteria open; every met criterion evidence-stamped as work happened; now-lines accurate (vm-disk and relocation-queue honestly disclose their branch pushes — a law deviation worth naming, not hiding). Reviewer mutations: vm-disk criterion 2 stamped met (evidence = d362d1f); nn-bl-daemon-leak-alerts and nn-bl-auto-relocate-gates retitled ABSORBED so the backlog stops advertising built work; two residue children filed and published (nn-bl-leaks-tick-cadence p2, nn-bl-orphans-json-purity p3). No fabrication found anywhere.

What the next wave takes

  1. Lead: merge the train in order, close the 8 merge-gate criteria + the 2 ABSORBED children, delete builder worktrees.
  2. Deploy v0.6.0 (rebuild + reinstall launchd daemon) — disk_space_history starts sampling, leak alerts go live; then PROVE the two deferred surfaces live: days-until-full after ~3 days, recurrence once leak suggestions persist.
  3. nn-bl-leaks-tick-cadence (p2) before any hot-machine rollout.
  4. The user's actual space relief (wave-1 handoff, still open): pin SATECHI in [offload], run the native-config relocations + guarded relocates — now with --defer for the locked ones and run-pending to finish them.
  5. nn-bl-resumable-copy (D23): run-pending over multi-GB queues is its designated consumer.
  6. Menubar (nn-bl-wails-ui, D26 embed prerequisite) once the CLI surfaces prove out.
